purpose: Held-out images for the final validation only. While config.HOLDOUT_MODE is DEV the pipeline refuses to process or display them, and no one may open them or their outputs during method development. See docs/HOLDOUT.md.
method: For each group of config.GROUPS: random.Random(f"{seed}:{group}").sample(sorted file names of data/<group>/*.tif, 2), then sorted. Python 3.9.10. Drawn from the file names only; no image was opened to choose.
